title: Engineering for Kestrel Pedestrian Bridge
short_description: Design services for a pedestrian and emergency access bridge over Bear Creek in Ashland.
project_scope: Design and permit a new pedestrian and emergency vehicle access bridge over Bear Creek as part of the Bear Creek Greenway extension through the City of Ashland. The notice indicates a multi-phase delivery including preliminary engineering, final engineering, permitting, easements, public outreach, bidding services, and construction management. No span, width, structural system, or construction quantities are stated.
services: Phase 1 preliminary engineering; Phase 2 final engineering, permitting, easements, public outreach, and bidding services; Phase 3 construction management services. Requested disciplines: civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, structural engineering, and hydrology/hydraulics.
relevance_explanation:
- Pedestrian bridge projects are generally of strong interest to sbp.
- The tender includes structural engineering and early design phases, creating a good entry point.
- Bridge over a creek may involve hydraulic and permitting complexity.
- Emergency vehicle access suggests higher loading requirements than a purely pedestrian bridge.
- However, no span or special structural features are provided, limiting evidence of exceptional complexity.
- The notice is only an advance notice and the RFP/Q was canceled, reducing immediate opportunity.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the notice. Available scope information: a new pedestrian and emergency vehicle access bridge over Bear Creek, with full design, permitting, easements, bidding, and construction management services. No span, deck area, structural type, or material is given, so a realistic cost estimate is not possible from this notice alone.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. The notice covers broad engineering services from preliminary engineering through construction management, but without construction cost, bridge size, or procurement details, a realistic engineering fee estimate is not possible.
references_qualifications: Disciplines requested: civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, structural engineering, and hydrology/hydraulics. No explicit reference requirements or minimum qualifications are stated in the notice.
contracting_authority: City of Ashland Public Works Department, Ashland, Oregon, USA. Contact: Scott Fleury. Email: scott.fleury@ashland.or.us. Phone: 541-488-5347. Website: https://oregonbuys.gov/bso/
notes: Advance notice only. The RFP/Q has been canceled and may be re-advertised in the future. IMS notes: no phone calls, no faxes, and no contact with the agency at this time. Source contains a typo in the project name: 'Pedestrain' interpreted as 'Pedestrian'.
